statements.subject: participant
statements.description: However, an RTSP proxy MAY modify the content-coding if the new coding is known to be acceptable to the recipient, unless the "no-transform" cache directive is present in the message.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: If the content-coding of a message body is not "identity", then the message MUST include a Content-Encoding message body header that lists the non-identity content-coding(s) used.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the content-coding of a message body in a request message is not acceptable to the origin server, the server SHOULD respond with a status code of 415 (Unsupported Media Type).

statements.subject: message
statements.description: If multiple encodings have been applied to a message body, the content-codings MUST be listed in the order in which they were applied, first to last from left to right.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Additional information about the encoding parameters MAY be provided by other header fields not defined by this specification.
